Spatially varying diffusion tensors

Source: R/assembly.R
tensor_coefficient.Rd

Builds a symmetric diffusion tensor K = [[xx, xy], [xy, yy]] whose entries are numbers or functions of (x, y) (or (x, y, t)), for anisotropic media whose principal directions or strengths vary in space. Use it wherever a diffusion coefficient is accepted. Positive definiteness is checked at every quadrature point during assembly.

Usage

tensor_coefficient(xx, xy = 0, yy = xx)

Arguments

xx, xy, yy

Tensor entries.

Value

An object of class pde_tensor.

Examples

# Diffusion aligned with circles around the origin
K <- tensor_coefficient(function(x, y) 1 + y^2, function(x, y) -x * y,
                        function(x, y) 1 + x^2)
p <- elliptic_problem(pde_mesh_rectangle(nx = 8), diffusion = K, source = 1,
                      bcs = dirichlet_bc(0))
max(solve_pde(p)$u$values)
#> [1] 0.05803095
